## Checklist

- [ ] New facts carry a tag: `[code]`, `[runtime]`, `[docs]` or `[unverified]`
- [ ] Scripts pass `php -l`, and read-only scripts still write nothing
- [ ] `claude plugin validate .` passes
- [ ] Tested on a staging or local Kadence site (for behaviour changes)
- [ ] No Kadence source code, licence keys, credentials or site data
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-facing changes
